look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson two
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 1, lesson T02, Why do crypto prices move; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: Same coin, new price
scenes.desc: A fictional BTC/USDT board ticks minute by minute; the question: who decides the price?

scenes.name: Buyers and sellers
scenes.desc: Buyer, seller and market price defined; a buyer and a seller agree and the last price updates.

scenes.name: Demand
scenes.desc: Demand defined with a mango-stall analogy; buyers outnumber sellers and the price ticks up.

scenes.name: Supply
scenes.desc: Supply defined with a closing-time fish stall; sellers pile up and the price ticks down.

scenes.name: Measuring a move
scenes.desc: Worked example: change in USDT and in percent, 60,000 to 61,200 and 60,000 to 57,000.

scenes.name: Buyer and seller strength
scenes.desc: Illustrative model: buyer and seller sliders move and the model price drifts up, down, sideways.

scenes.name: Not a headcount
scenes.desc: Three buyers wanting 12 BTC outweigh ten sellers offering 2 BTC: size matters, not headcount.

scenes.name: Liquidity
scenes.desc: Liquidity defined: the same 1 BTC buy barely moves a deep market but lifts a thin one 400 USDT.

scenes.name: Volatility
scenes.desc: Volatility defined: a calm line and a wild line; surprise news makes a sudden jump.

scenes.name: Not a smooth line
scenes.desc: Common mistake: price as a smooth line; zoom in to a jagged path that can turn at any time.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and calculate: 60,000 to 63,000 USDT is +3,000 USDT, +5%.

scenes.name: Know the risks
scenes.desc: Sudden moves, no one knows the next move, WAIT / NO_TRADE is always allowed, models are not markets.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T03, Trading pairs: BTC/USDT.
